scope: isolated Node logic fixtures; no real OD access, pixel proof or publication
dependency_note: Copied source dependencies; only the scratch schema action enums were extended with planned refine. Root must rerun against final actual dependencies.
fixes: Preserve every exact text node including blank text, textarea/pre data and default field values.
Require an effective supported inline CSS declaration change; reject class-only and invalid/unsupported new declarations.
Preserve every opaque original declaration raw segment exactly.
Default all opaque properties to potentially overlapping with any changed supported key; only exact font-family and box-shadow longhands are known independent.
Reject opaque text-decoration resets, all six logical sizing aliases and unknown future properties regardless of declaration order or !important.
Normalize supported values, expand supported shorthands and respect duplicate/important declaration priority.
Retain independent semantic acceptance and existing script/global CSS/asset/scope guards.

static_css_boundary.opaque_policy: Within a changed style attribute, all other opaque declarations block supported declaration changes regardless of order or priority. Unchanged style attributes elsewhere do not block another element's supported change.
static_css_boundary.evidence_kind: bounded inline declaration cascade; does not establish computed pixel difference or behavior equivalence
